customCommands.name: autosentry
customCommands.prompt:
You are helping the user with autosentry — a self-healing supervisor for long-running processes. Open AGENTS.md at the repo root and follow the playbook. Quick router:

1. `command -v autosentry && autosentry --version` → if missing, suggest: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ulmentflam/autosentry/main/install.sh | sh`
2. `[ -f .autosentry/autosentry.yaml ] || [ -f autosentry.yaml ]` → if missing, run `autosentry init` and walk through process.command, config_snapshots, detectors, rules.
3. `[ -f .autosentry/state.json ]` → if missing, launch: `nohup autosentry run > /dev/null 2>&1 &`
4. Running → use `autosentry status`, `autosentry watch`, `autosentry web`, `autosentry incidents list/show`, `autosentry analyze --since 24h`.

Claude-driven fixes land on `autosentry/fix-<incident-id>` branches and only stick if the same detector doesn't re-fire inside the verify window. Trust `attempts.tsv` — `status` column is the ground truth.

Be terse. One or two sentences per action.
